WARNING: This file is NOT where your settings are stored.
This file is only used to display the settings in the game.
The file you are looking for is 'settings.txt' in your saves folder.
If you want to change your settings, edit that file instead.

disasters: This may result in up to 1/3rd of your Warren dying in one moon.
showxp: Show exact XP and nutrition status
Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
random med rabbit: Allow healer rabbits to be randomly selected on patrol
Healer rabbits can be selected with the patrol buttons +1, +3,+6.
fading: Allow dead rabbits to fade away
After 202 moons, dead rabbits will be unloaded, and saved separately. No family relations will be lost.
save_faded_copy: Save a complete copy of faded rabbits information
A complete copy of faded rabbit save info will be saved in plain-text.
backgrounds: Even with this off, the burrow you choose will still affect the events you encounter.
moons and seasons: Displays Warren age and current Warren season on several pages.

captain: Allow chief rabbits to automatically choose a new captain
The Rabbit Code rules will be taken into account when choosing a captain.
12_moon_graduation: All rusasirahs will graduate at 12 moons.
retirement: Rabbits will never retire due to a permanent condition
When this setting is off, rabbits with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire.
become_mediator: Allow rabbits and elders to choose to become owslas
Rabbits and elders will have a chance to become owslas upon timeskip.

affair: Allow rabbits to breed with rabbits that aren't their mates
This will allow mated and unmated rabbits to have kits with other rabbits they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
same sex birth: Allow all rabbits to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth kits despite same-sex status.
same sex adoption: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
single parentage: Allow rabbits to have kits with an unknown second parent
Allow rabbits to have kits with an unknown second biological parent. The rabbit will be listed as the only biological parent.
romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
Allows mentors and the rabbits they trained to be romantic after they become rabbits.
first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
Allows rabbits with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.

by-status: The Warren will be fed according their status and within the status by age.
younger first: The Warren will be fed according to their age only.
less nutrition first: First the rabbits with the lowest nutrition will be fed, afterwards the Warren will be fed according to their status.
hunter first: Firstly the rabbits with a hunter skill will be fed, afterwards the Warren will be fed according to their status.
sick/injured first: Firstly the sick and injured rabbits will be fed, afterwards the Warren will be fed according to their status.
more experience first: The Warren will be fed according their experience, highest one first.
ration prey: Healthy rabbits will only eat half of the food they need, even if there is enough for the Warren.

business as usual: The Warren has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
hunting: The Warren will focus on hunting, each working rabbit (including captain and chief rabbit) and each working rusasirah will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
herb gathering: The Warren will focus on herb gathering, each healer and healer rusasirah will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the rabbits.
threaten outsiders: The relationship with rabbits outside of the Warren decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from your rabbits.
seek outsiders: The relationship with rabbits outside of the Warren increases as your rabbits make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
rest and recover: The Warren will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
sabotage other clans: Your owslas and rabbits work together to undermine the other Warrens. Only available if you have a working owsla. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Warrens you target.
aid other clans: Your owsla and rabbits work together to help the other Warrens with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working owsla. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Warrens you target.
raid other clans: Your rabbits begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Warrens decrease. You will be able to choose which Warrens you target.
hoarding: Your rabbits begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their paws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
